title: Tensor-unit powers turn numerator maps into scalar maps
statement: For a scheme Y [def-pc-scheme], an O_Y-module G [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and a global function b, let L be the tensor unit, s its section b times the standard generator, and let the tensor powers and numerator maps be those of [lem-pc-section-clearing-denominators]. There are isomorphisms i_n:G tensor L^n ≅ G such that mulTensorPowSection(s,G,0,n);i_(0+n) = i_0;smulHom(G,b^n) for every natural n. This is an identity of sheaf morphisms, before cohomology, with no resolution or scheme morphism involved.

proof.text: Define the unit-power isomorphism recursively by the identity in degree zero and the tensor of the identity with the preceding isomorphism, followed by the left unitor, in successor degree. Induct using tensorPowSectionOne_succ, homOfGlobalSection_app_one, tensorHom_app_tmulSection and leftUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection to show that the nth section power maps to the restricted function b^n times the unit generator. The proof is the private unitPowerIso_section.

Tensor the unit-power isomorphism with G and compose with the right unitor. Precompose the required equality with i_0 inverse and test on every section x. The inverse right unitor sends x to x tensor 1. mulTensorPowSection_app_tmulSection sends this to x tensor s^(0+n). The preceding induction and rightUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection identify its image as b^n x. smulHom_app_apply gives the same expression on the other side. Equality on all sections proves equality of sheaf morphisms. No nonzero or nonempty assumption is used.

theorem tensorUnitPower_scalar (Y : Scheme.{u}) (G : Y.Modules) (b : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    let L := 𝟙_ Y.Modules
    let s : Γ(L, ⊤) := unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ b
    ∃ i : ∀ n : ℕ, (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules) ≅ G,
      ∀ n : ℕ, mulTensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) G 0 n ≫
        (i (0 + n)).hom = (i 0).hom ≫ G.smulHom (b ^ n)
